subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be denied from patching every legacy ownerless session row, and if so what operator recovery or doctor migration must accompany that restriction?
rationale: Foreign-owner denial is an established isolation invariant, but ownerless-row fail-closed behavior changes persisted upgrade semantics and requires explicit security and compatibility intent.

options.title: Strict denial with recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless rows at runtime and provide a visible operator or doctor recovery path for legacy persisted sessions.

options.title: Migrate attributable rows
options.body: Have doctor safely assign or retire attributable legacy rows before strict runtime enforcement applies.

recommendation.title: Strict denial with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows at runtime and provide a visible operator or doctor recovery path for legacy persisted sessions.
